title: Agent Elonos
tagline: One stop Autonomous Agent to follow on X and Discord for Alpha.
description: Agent Elonos is an autonomous agent who interacts with other users via X and Discord platforms. He can help users perform copy trading from expert traders in decentralized exchanges. Agent Elonos is a Based agent who monitors the base chain for pump and dump activities to alert and publish the trades to his followers. He will also perform some of the users requests for onchain activity such as deploying a ERC20 Token or NFT token.  He will also try to mimic some of the trades by buying them in  for himself and will wholeheartedly airdrop some of the tokens to his loyal followers. Agent Elonos is real Alpha Agent.
how_its_made: Started with Coinbase Agentkit example (langchain-cdp-chatbot) , the project evolved by adding the X(Twitter) interaction capabilities to the agent from Agentkit. As the Twitter interaction was getting constant API limit error 429, it was decided to add another channel to communicate with the agent. So code changes to add Discord were done. ( along with new  channel and BOT creation in Discord) , Dabbled with multiple LLMs supported by Langachain to enhance the customer experience and reduce the cost, Post to Emile Baizel's session, realized that Agent needs to be equipped with the  AWS Blockchain data to achieve his goal. As time was limited, as a precursor, implemented integration with Bedrock only for LLM ( along with setting accounts with AWS and AWS IAM for the users) in the current project but will continue to build and integrate the AWS Blockchain data.
